messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: region=eu-north-1 severity=sev2 — elevated 5xx and latency for Hosted API and Dedicated pools. Suspect external identity sync (third-party IDP) causing cred-broker timeouts and retry fanout. Paging @maria (oncall) @leo (prod-sre) :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): acked, joining. any quick visibility?

dexter (eng-runtime): seeing large spike in token-refresh errors hitting cred-broker -> STS. auth.errors/sec from ~2 to ~120 in 3m. token_refresh p95 1.2s -> 6.1s. sample logs below:
```
2026-03-17T21:45:10Z cred-broker -> idp timeout 504 host=idp-eu-1.okta.net
2026-03-17T21:46:02Z cred-broker retry flood, queue depth 384
```

leo (prod-sre): ok, can we route EU traffic to fallback region (us-east-1) and reduce token refresh concurrency in the cred-broker? Need quick mitigations before scaling.

maria (oncall): rolling mitigations now: 1) enable cross-region fallback routing eu-north-1 -> us-east-1 for inference API 2) set cred_broker.max_parallel_refresh=4 3) scale Dedicated eu-north-1 pools +2 nodes (hot-add). Executing commands.

ops-bot: runbook step executed: apply-route-policy rp-904 (eu-north-1 -> us-east-1-fallback) :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: config update applied: cred_broker.max_parallel_refresh=4 :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: autoscaler requested +2 nodes to dedicated-pool-eu-north-1 (policy: emergency-burst) :white_check_mark:

dexter (eng-runtime): note — cross-region adds ~80-140ms tail latency for some routes but should cut 5xx fast. watch for TLS/cert pin issues.

alia (support): logging impacted customer list: AcmeCorp (enterprise), FinWave, MedlyHealth. opening priority support threads and emailing AMs.

jamal (customer-advocate): drafting status blurb for status.redwood.ai: "Users in EU-NORD may see increased errors and latency. We're routing requests to alternate region and applying caching mitigations. Engineers are actively monitoring. ETA 15-30m." Will post in 5m if no regressions.

maria (oncall): quick metrics update: at peak ~12% of requests returned 5xx for eu-north-1, current 5xx rate down to ~4% after routing+config. p95 latency still elevated for token-heavy flows.

leo (prod-sre): can we bump credential cache TTL for Dedicated pools to reduce refresh pressure? e.g. cred_cache.ttl from 120s -> 600s for dedicated-pool-eu-north-1. If safe, do it.

dexter (eng-runtime): applied cred_cache.ttl=600s on dedicated-pool-eu-north-1. Also enabled short-circuit KV prefix caching for token validation routes. Changes live.

maria (oncall): handing over oncall to @leo for next 2h — I'll step off in 3m. Summary: root cause appears external IDP degraded causing cred-broker timeouts -> retry fanout -> elevated 5xx. Mitigations: cross-region fallback, reduced refresh concurrency, TTL bump, +2 nodes dedicated. Impact reduced from ~12% -> ~3-5%. Monitoring for regressions and vendor updates.

leo (prod-sre): taking over. I'll keep watch and escalate to IDP vendor if errors climb. Creating vendor ticket and adding contacts. tagging: @OktaStatus (ping on their page) and recording vendor ticket number in incident.

incident-bot: escalation created: INC-2026-1458. vendor contact added to incident record.

alia (support): support update sent to AcmeCorp + FinWave. scheduled follow-up call 22:45 UTC.

jamal (customer-advocate): recommending proactive credit/adjustment for heavily impacted customers — flagging finance and CS ops.

maria (oncall): thanks all, stepping off. :heart:

leo (prod-sre): continuing watch. If stable for 30m we'll close the page and mark mitigations for post-incident review (include replay of cred-broker queueing). tagging SRE for follow-up RCA and vendor postmortem.

ops-bot: monitoring set: 5xx_alert_threshold=5% (30s window), escalation window=10m.

incident-bot: thread closed for initial page handoff at 6167894921 (oncall owner: leo).
